[ASSISTANT_SAID] When shopping for eco-friendly sunscreen, look for reef-safe ingredients, mineral active ingredients, certifications, and non-whitening formulas.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Reminder to apply sunscreen liberally, reapply every two hours, and use in conjunction with other sun protection measures.  
[PREFERENCE] User has been using a different brand of sunscreen but is willing to try a new one.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in Goddess Garden Organics Everyday Natural Sunscreen.  
[EVENT] User inquired about the availability of Goddess Garden Organics Everyday Natural Sunscreen in a refillable container.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Goddess Garden Organics offers a refill option for their Everyday Natural Sunscreen through a "Refill Pouch" program.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The refill pouch is made of recyclable materials and designed to be reused.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Steps for the refill program include purchasing the initial product, cleaning the empty tube, ordering a refill pouch, and pouring the new sunscreen into the original tube.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The refill program can reduce waste by up to 70% compared to traditional sunscreen packaging.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The refill pouch option is available on the Goddess Garden Organics website or authorized online retailers
